comments.content:
Issue first is what most CONTRIBUTING files already ask for, and it's the step drive-by PRs skip, agent-written or not. A setting would turn the request into a gate.

Until then, an Action that closes PRs with no linked issue gets close, though you still get the notification.

issue approval answers "do we want this change?" i'm trying the next gate with PullViva: questions about the submitted diff before merge. neither replaces the other. a perfectly understood patch can still be work the maintainer never asked for.
